name: Sierpinski Replika Workshop
backstory: A repaired synthetic technician relies on practical close-range equipment and a guarded credit reserve. The workshop concentrates upgrades and refinement on one functioning frame.
strategy_personality: An industrial synthetic technician with a recognizable dark uniform, distinctive head and limb construction, and restrained red accents. Preserve the game's Replika identity rather than treating Elster as an ordinary human in futuristic armour. A resource-conscious Paragon with practical equipment fits the survival atmosphere. Select a specific reference state and weapon; alternate Elster units are not automatically additional roster members.

robots.name: Elster
robots.art_brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around every extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.


Subject: ONE Elster, LSTR-512 Replika from SIGNALIS (2022), recognizably synthetic adult female humanoid with pale humanlike face, short straight black bob hair, source red-and-black technical bodysuit/uniform, red shoulder and upper torso panels, exposed dark mechanical articulated limb segments, dark gloves and full boots. Preserve the original game's proportions and silhouette with faithful realistic materials, not a generic human soldier. One compact service pistol held lowered safely in the right hand, left hand free; no extra weapon. Complete body including boots, calm alert three-quarter pose.
Metadata only, do not render text: #184 slot 1 Elster.
robots.refinement_note: Apply only after the final loadout is equipped. Main-hand operations affect that item instance only; a second weapon copy stays unrefined. The shield receives only its listed Hone. No unverified weapon attribute is added.
robots.equipment_interpretation: Elster fills the flexible line fighter role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. Arena main/offhand allocations can use fitted mounts or tool adapters; extra limbs, integrated source weapons and alternate forms grant no additional slots or combat effects.
robots.combat_rationale: Versatile tuning supports the short equipment role; balanced stance and a 15% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Paragon strategy tuning rules with the Versatile Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.
robots.design_basis: New arena build authored for this collection using supplied equipment prices, hand compatibility and verified refinement examples. Original source identity and final artwork remain authoritative for appearance.
